# Youth Medical Journal

> > A student-led, peer-reviewed medical journal publishing original research and literature reviews by youth scientists on cutting-edge biomedical topics.

Youth Medical Journal is the first student-led medical journal, founded to provide a platform for young researchers to publish peer-reviewed articles on diverse health science topics. The journal accepts manuscript submissions from student scientists and maintains editorial standards comparable to professional medical publications.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed articles
- Student-led publication
- Biomedical research
- Neuroscience
- Mental health

## Neuroscience & Neurological Research

- [The Link Between Schizophrenia and Neuroplasticity](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2020/12/21/the-link-between-schizophrenia-and-neuroplasticity): Research review on schizophrenia, neuroplasticity, and drug use connections
- [Advancements in Neurosurgery through Technology and Robotics](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/12/23/advancements-in-neurosurgery-through-technology-and-robotics-a-comprehensive-review): Comprehensive review of robotic and technological advances in neurosurgery
- [Cognitive effects of Hemispherectomy on Children and Adolescents](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2024/01/11/cognitive-effects-of-hemispherectomy-on-children-and-adolescents-a-review): Literature review on cognitive outcomes of hemispherectomy in pediatric patients
- [The Effects of Music Therapy on Neurological Disorders](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/03/31/the-effects-of-music-therapy-on-neurological-disorders): Article on music therapy applications for neurological disorder treatment

## Mental Health & Psychology

- [The Impact of Social Media on Peer Pressure in Adolescents](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2022/01/12/the-impact-of-social-media-on-peer-pressure-in-adolescents): Research article on social media effects and peer pressure in adolescents
- [The Relationship Between Traumatic Events And The Growth Of Individuals](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/03/31/the-relationship-between-traumatic-events-and-the-growth-of-individuals): Research on trauma types and psychological growth in individuals

## Biomedical & Life Sciences

- [The Future of Genetic Engineering](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2021/03/21/the-future-of-genetic-engineering): Article examining genetic engineering advances, ethics, and designer babies
- [mRNA vaccines](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/03/31/mrna-vaccines): Overview of mRNA vaccine technology and cancer treatment potential
- [The Effect of Substances During Pregnancy](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/02/15/the-effect-of-substances-during-pregnancy): Research on substance effects during pregnancy and fetal development
- [The HeLa cells: Exploring Their Importance and Ethical Issues](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/03/06/the-hela-cells-exploring-their-importance-and-ethical-issues): Article on HeLa cells, medical contributions, and ethical implications

## Medical History & Education

- [Early Studies of Human Anatomy: The Root of Modern Medicine](https://youthmedicaljournal.com/2023/03/06/early-studies-of-human-anatomy-the-root-of-modern-medicine): Historical analysis of human anatomy studies from ancient times to Renaissance
